title: Delftia sp. isolate:IITD-KLINJ-A01 Genome sequencing and assembly
description: We report the whole genome sequence of D.tsuruhatensis IITD-KLINJ-A01 strain. The sample was isolated from a microbial fuel cell inoculated with domestic wastewater from domestic wastewater of Indian Institute of Technology, New Delhi, India and was sequenced using nanopore sequencing.
samples: MIMAG Metagenome-assembled Genome sample from Delftia sp.
domestic wastewater enriched in microbial fuel cell with added fumarate (F1)
domestic wastewater enrichment F1 with added fumarate
